description: Druid / Balance: CLASS-TREE REFERENCE ONLY. Original paraphrases inspired by remembered Dragonflight / The War Within hybrid design; not verified Midnight data. Numbers, ranks, placement and sparse connections are illustrative. Specialization, Apex and Hero trees are intentionally not populated. Uses the workbook's 34-point budget, not a claim about retail point totals. All Druid references share identical class nodes.

designNotes.status: Synthetic memory-inspired class-only brainstorming baseline; not an official tree or a balance simulation.

baselineAssumptions.spellNotes: For this design model only. A form unlock may expose a basic toolkit; the game does not universally grant every listed spell identically at every level. Rebirth is the combat resurrection, Revive the out-of-combat resurrection. Mark of the Wild is a group buff, not a talent purchase counted below.
baselineAssumptions.allocationCaveat: Moonkin Form, Swiftmend, Starsurge, Wild Growth and other borrowed-role access have moved or changed between expansions. This synthetic class tree uses remembered hybrid design, not a claim about current Midnight placement. Wild Growth is discussed as an optional alternative, not included as a node here.

designNotes.graphRules: Sparse forward prerequisite links only; all other nodes are roots. This is not a reconstructed retail path graph. No 8/20-point gates or level requirements are asserted. There are no encoded choice nodes, auto-granted ranks or import strings for the game.
designNotes.tuningRules: Slash-separated values are Rank 1 / Rank 2. Listed values are provisional examples. Cooldown reductions are additive except where explicitly described otherwise. No cooldown may fall below 1 second. Effective healing excludes overhealing. Baseline cooldown, resource and proc interactions need testing before implementation.
